profile.role_note: Free universal healer and buffer; Outro deepens the whole team's DMG.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Free and universal — claim her from the standard selector if you haven't; she fits every team that isn't running Shorekeeper.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Variation (or Stellar Symphony) + 5-piece Rejuvenating Glow in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Fallacy of No Return in the main slot. Aim for a Healing Bonus 4-cost, Energy Regen 3-costs, ATK% 1-costs, and as much Energy Regen as possible — her 175-energy Liberation is her whole rotation.

ranked_weapons.name: Variation
ranked_weapons.note: The classic Verina weapon and the community consensus #1: Energy Regen plus Concerto Energy on Resonance Skill. Accessible and excellent.

ranked_weapons.name: Stellar Symphony
ranked_weapons.note: Shorekeeper's signature; strong Energy Regen, HP%, and team ATK on heal — a premium alternative, but not hers.

ranked_weapons.name: Cosmic Ripples
ranked_weapons.note: Free at Union Level 45; ATK% substat boosts her ATK-scaling heals with a little Energy Regen.

ranked_weapons.name: Rectifier#25
ranked_weapons.note: Energy Regen with a small ATK boost; recommended over Cosmic Ripples by some guides.

ranked_weapons.name: Call of the Abyss
ranked_weapons.note: Healing and Energy Regen; solid free option. Free last-resort alternative: the 3-star Rectifier of Voyager.

echo_sets.name: Rejuvenating Glow
echo_sets.note: Boosts her healing and grants the team 15% ATK for 30s. Bell-Borne Geochelone is a popular main-echo alternative for its shield.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Energy Regen and an ATK buff for the next Resonator; loses some healing and the universal buff.

stat_priorities.note: Healing Bonus is standard; ATK% works since her heals scale off ATK.
ATK% on both; feeds her ATK-scaling heals.

build.energy_regen_target: not published; as high as possible (Liberation costs 175 energy)

teams.name: Classic: Jiyan + Mortefi + Verina

members.name: Jiyan
members.note: Launch-era AoE carry; in his Liberation state every attack is a fast Heavy Attack.

members.name: Mortefi
members.note: Outro grants 38% Heavy Attack DMG; his Liberation turret fires on Heavy and Basic Attacks.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Heals and buffs; her Outro's All-Type DMG Deepen affects the whole team.

teams.rotation: Verina keeps the team alive and buffed, Mortefi drops his Liberation turret and Outro for the 38% Heavy Attack buff, then Jiyan enters his Liberation state and shreds with rapid Heavy Attacks.

teams.name: Alternative: Augusta + Iuno + Verina

members.name: Augusta
members.note: Heavy-attack hypercarry that benefits from Verina's all-type DMG Deepen.

members.name: Iuno
members.note: Heavy Attack buffer and healer; builds Wan Light stacks for Augusta.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Universal healer/buffer; a documented pairing for the Augusta/Iuno duo.

teams.rotation: Verina sustains and deepens team damage, Iuno runs her Lunar Cycle for Heavy Attack buffs and Wan Light stacks, then Augusta takes her extended heavy-attack window.

sequences.verdict: S0 is a complete healer/buffer. Aim S2 for faster rotations, S6 only for whales.

pull_path.why: Full healing plus 15% all-type DMG and 20% ATK buffs at S0.
+1 Photosynthesis Energy and +10 Concerto on skill — the rotation shortcut both guides flag.
Starflower Blooms trigger coordinated attacks that heal the team.

sequences.weapon_vs_dupes: No 5-star signature — Variation is the consensus BiS and easy to obtain; skip dupes entirely, S2 at most.
